card.name: Missed-dose instructions: time limit wording
card.fires_on: Words in the missed-dose instruction right after 'as soon as possible', where the text sets a time limit before the next dose, such as 'less than', 'more than 4 hours have passed', or 'almost time'.

modes.label: Time-limit wording
modes.description: Linking words inside the condition on how close the next dose is.
modes.example: unless it is less<< than>> 12 hours before the next dose

modes.label: Skip-dose clause

modes.description: Words after 'as soon as' in the missed-dose sentence.
modes.example: take any missed doses as soon as they<< remember>>, unless more than 12 hours
